The UK Foreign Office has been asked to intervene to secure the release of a British-Egyptian woman who it is claimed has been arrested in Cairo because of her sister’s political activism.
Eman el-Shazly, a 45-year-old based in Birmingham, was arrested on 16 August while visiting Egypt. Her lawyers say she has been detained in an attempt to silence her sister Mona, a relentless and harsh critic of the Egyptian government on her UK-based YouTube channel.

topArticle.title: Moringa lattes and tigernut kebabs: the Ghanaians ‘taking back the power’ of their food

In Ghana, a grassroots movement is championing nutritious, homegrown, climate-resilient produce, rather than western imports
After three years at catering school in Accra, Abiro Wisdom was certain of one thing – he did not want to go into catering. At least not the route that he might be expected to take. His course had prepared students for working in international hotels, focusing on French, Italian and Mexican cuisine. The nutritious, homegrown food that Wisdom had eaten while growing up in Bolgatanga, northern Ghana, did not feature at all.
“I didn’t see myself there,” he says of the big chain hotels. “I felt I wouldn’t be myself working there – I wouldn’t be able to talk about the food from where I come from.”

topArticle.titleJa: 市民権を武器化する：ニカラグアでの異論封じ
topArticle.summary: ニカラグアにおける権威主義政府が、市民権剥奪を通じて反対意見を封じ込める手法を検証。市民の権利を侵害する動きと政治的抑圧の実態に焦点を当て、その深刻な影響を分析する。

topArticle.title: The question dominating Indian politics: Is it worse when women swear?
topArticle.description: Rahul Gandhi's comments renew the debate over gender disparity in reactions to insults hurled at PM Narendra Modi.
topArticle.titleJa: インド政治を席巻する問い：女性が罵倒するのはより悪いのか？
topArticle.summary: ラフル・ガンジー氏の発言が、モディ首相への罵倒に対する反応における男女格差の議論を再燃させ、インド政治で活発な議論が交わされている。

topArticle.title: British man charged in Singapore two years after alleged theft at airport
topArticle.description: The 26-year-old faces up to seven years in jail for allegedly stealing a denim jacket from an airport shop in 2024.
topArticle.titleJa: シンガポールで英国人男性、空港での窃盗容疑で2年後に起訴
topArticle.summary: シンガポールの空港でデニムジャケットを盗んだとされる英国人男性（26歳）が、2年後に起訴された。最大7年の懲役刑に直面する可能性がある。

topArticle.title: New Zealand to introduce bill for under-16s social media ban
topArticle.description: The government faces opposition to its proposals from MPs who believe a ban will not work.
topArticle.titleJa: ニュージーランド、16歳未満のSNS利用禁止法案を提出へ
topArticle.summary: ニュージーランド政府は、16歳未満のソーシャルメディア利用を禁止する法案を提出する予定だ。議員からはその有効性について反対意見も出ている。

topArticle.title: United Kingdom launches safeguard investigation on polyethylene terephthalate
topArticle.description: On 5 August 2026, the United Kingdom notified the WTO’s Committee on Safeguards that it had initiated, on the same day, a safeguard investigation on imports of certain polyethylene terephthalate (PET).
topArticle.titleJa: 英国、ポリエチレンテレフタレートに関するセーフガード調査を開始
topArticle.summary: 英国は2026年8月5日、特定のポリエチレンテレフタレート（PET）輸入に対しセーフガード調査を開始したとWTOに通知した。

topArticle.title: WTO panel issues report regarding Turkish measures on EVs and other types of vehicles
topArticle.description: On 28 July, the WTO circulated the panel report in the case brought by China in "Türkiye — Measures Concerning Electric Vehicles and Other Types of Vehicles from China" (DS629).
topArticle.titleJa: WTOパネル、トルコのEVおよびその他車両に関する措置の報告書を発表
topArticle.summary: WTOは7月28日、中国が提起した「トルコにおける電気自動車等に関する措置」に関するパネル報告書を配布した。

topArticle.title: Lithuania gives EUR 30,000 to help developing economies and LDCs improve trade skillset
topArticle.description: Lithuania is contributing EUR 30,000 (approximately CHF 28,000) in 2026 to finance training programmes for government officials from developing economies, including least-developed countries (LDCs). This contribution to the WTO Global Trust Fund will support these economies in deepening their expertise on WTO issues and help them participate more effectively in the rules-based multilateral trading system.
topArticle.titleJa: リトアニア、発展途上国・後発開発途上国の貿易スキル向上に3万ユーロを供与
topArticle.summary: リトアニアは、発展途上国および後発開発途上国の政府職員向け貿易研修プログラムに3万ユーロを拠出する。

topArticle.title: Uzbekistan reaffirms 2026 WTO accession goal, thanks members for continuing engagement
topArticle.description: Uzbekistan reaffirmed its determination to complete its WTO accession process within 2026 at a meeting of the Working Party on the Accession of Uzbekistan on 27 and 28 July, soon after its last meeting in March. The head of Uzbekistan's delegation, Chief Negotiator Azizbek Urunov, stressed that maintaining a strong pace of engagement and addressing members' remaining concerns will be critical to bringing the accession process to a successful conclusion.
topArticle.titleJa: ウズベキスタン、2026年のWTO加盟目標を再確認し、継続的な関与に感謝
topArticle.summary: ウズベキスタンは7月27〜28日の会合で、2026年までのWTO加盟プロセス完了への決意を再確認した。
